---
title: "03_augment"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Intention

input file: 02_dat_clean.tsv\
output file: 03_dat_aug.tsv

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

```{r}
data_clean <- read_tsv(here("data/02_dat_clean.tsv"))
```

Add variables describing each sample

```{r}
data_aug <- data_clean |>
  mutate(Group = case_when(Tissue_type == "CE" ~ "Control",
                           Tissue_type == "CP" ~ "Control",
                           TRUE ~ "Patient"),
         Tissue = case_when(Tissue_type == "CE" ~ "Endometrium",
                            Tissue_type == "PE" ~ "Endometrium",
                            Tissue_type == "CP" ~ "Peritoneum",
                            Tissue_type == "PP" ~ "Peritoneum",
                            TRUE ~ "Lesion"),
         Lesion_type = case_when(Tissue_type == "PeLR" ~ "Peritoneal lesion",
                                 Tissue_type == "PeLB" ~ "Peritoneal lesion",
                                 Tissue_type == "PeLW" ~ "Peritoneal lesion",
                                 Tissue_type == "OMA" ~ "Ovarian endometrioma",
                                 Tissue_type == "DiEIn" ~ "Deep infiltrating",
                                 Tissue_type == "DiEB" ~ "Deep infiltrating",
                                 Tissue_type == "SuL" ~ "Deep infiltrating",
                                 Tissue_type == "REV" ~ "Deep infiltrating"),
         Plot_group = case_when(Tissue == "Lesion" ~ Lesion_type,
                                TRUE ~ str_c(Group, " ", str_to_lower(Tissue)))) |>
  relocate(Sample, Tissue_type, Group, Tissue, Lesion_type, Plot_group)
```

Check that every tissue code got the right labels

```{r}
data_aug |>
  count(Tissue_type, Group, Tissue, Lesion_type, Plot_group)
```

```{r}
write_tsv(data_aug,
          here("data/03_dat_aug.tsv"))
```
